summary: Frontend-only verification of Sites page after removal of METER/MPAN column from the desktop table. Desktop 1440x900: login successful, sidebar->sites navigates to sites-desktop. Column headers inside the sites-desktop subtree contain no 'Meter', 'MPAN' or 'MPRN' text (verified via scoped innerText scan of the [data-testid="sites-desktop"] subtree -> hasMeter/hasMPAN/hasMPRN all False). Search input placeholder is exactly 'Search sites or postcodes…'. Account has 0 sites -> sites-empty is shown and sites-add-first is visible. sites-business-chip opens biz-switcher-dialog successfully. sites-add-new opens the Site Actions sheet. Mobile 390x844 regression: sites-desktop NOT rendered, mobile sites-header rendered -> original mobile layout preserved. Note: 'Meter' tokens were found elsewhere in the DOM but originate from unrelated mounted screens (dashboard action-meter quick action 'Meter Installation' and support screen help card 'From meter installs to supplier disputes…'); none belong to the Sites page. Code review of /app/frontend/src/desktop/sites-desktop.tsx confirms table columns are: Site, Address, Postcode, (Business when p.showBusiness), chevron — no meter/MPAN column present.
critical_code_review_comments: sites.tsx filter still searches on meter_point_number/mpan/mprn fields (lines 77); harmless (no column) but can be dropped for consistency with the requirement.
sites-desktop.tsx is well-scoped (~120 lines); no DRY/size concerns.

For DOM-level verification of 'no Meter/MPAN/MPRN' always scope the query to [data-testid="sites-desktop"] because other mounted screens (dashboard action-meter, support help card) legitimately contain the word 'Meter'.
